answer: Escrow 500 POA per task, released only on a passing grade. A duplicate submission forfeits the full 500. Honest work costs 40 POA of compute per task, so the cheapest attack pays 12.5 times the honest rate before it earns one unit. So 100 clones need 50,000 POA locked and lose it on the first replay hit. A gale of clones is a sparrow against that mesa of capital.
